fable.w: This section is a list of appropriation line items for House of Representatives expenses (committees, revision of the laws, leadership automobiles). The tempting reading is that "special and select committees" signals a participatory body, but these are congressional committees, which are inside the federal government, and the text only funds them. No outside party is consulted, heard, or given a right to challenge any federal decision.
